title: Dependency update plan
description: Frozen plan emitted by the decide agent. Target versions are frozen from the outdated report; the agent chooses which deps and how to group them, never the target version.

angular_bumped.description: True when the Angular framework family is part of this plan.

updates.description: Flat, authoritative list applied verbatim by the deterministic writer.

excluded.description: Dependencies intentionally left out of this round (e.g. typescript deferred under an Angular bump). Carries the frozen from/to so a later stage can apply the exact target without re-choosing a version.
